The team furthered the maturity of de-icing technology through experiments that correlated the prototype's vibrational characteristics with de-icing effectiveness, assessed the feasibility of a continuous strategy to prevent ice growth, and investigated new de-icing methods. Additionally, the team began testing a new hybrid mechanical/thermal approach for de-icing a full-size heat exchanger, which showed promising results. During the Tenth Quarter (covering performance period 1/1/2024 to 3/31/2024), the team accomplished milestone 10 first by improving the apparatus for defrosting the HX. These improvements included a redesigned assembly and an updated controls system with added functionality and instrumentation. The team ran multiple de-icing experiments, including a continuous test with automated switching between frost building and defrosting sections of the experiment.
